title: gateway oscore store tests leak temp dirs when an assert fails mid-test
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz), robustness pass. The persistent-store tests remove their temp dirs only at the end (remove_dir_all after the last assert, e.g. gateway.rs:2062-2084); an early assert failure leaks the dir in std::env::temp_dir. Acceptable for CI (next runs never collide thanks to pid+AtomicU64 naming), but a std::path::Path guard struct or a small drop-guard helper would clean up on failure. Low value; bundle with any future test work in this file.
